SourceProxy.label: SHYX Image AntiAlias
SourceProxy.name: SHYXImageAntiAlias

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Image AntiAlias: optional resample, then Whitaker constrained curvature flow to remove voxel staircasing (ITK via VMTK).

SourceProxy.Documentation: Binary vtkImageData anti-alias using itk::AntiAliasBinaryImageFilter from the ITK that ships with VMTK (same VMTK_DIR as SHYX VMTK Centerlines). Optional vtkImageResample first: ResampleFactor > 1 refines (more voxels, smaller spacing), < 1 coarsens, 1 skips. Occupancy-constrained mean curvature flow rounds voxel stairs; the 0.5-voxel lock is in output voxel units, so a 2× upsample allows a tighter world-space round. Output is a float level set on the resampled grid (inside > 0, outside < 0); extract the surface with Contour at 0. Not SHYX Image Morphology and not Gaussian blur. Requires VESPA_USE_VMTK.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Uniform rectilinear image or volume. Point-centered 1-component scalars (binary mask or a field that can be thresholded to one).

StringVectorProperty.name: SelectInputScalars
StringVectorProperty.label: Scalars
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Point scalar to anti-alias. Replaced on output by a float level set. If Resample Factor is 1, other arrays pass through; if the grid changes, only the level set and field data are kept.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ResampleFactor
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Resample Factor
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Magnification applied before anti-alias (vtkImageResample). 1 = original grid. Greater than 1 refines (e.g. 2 doubles samples per axis, halves spacing). Less than 1 coarsens (e.g. 0.5). 2D volumes (single Z slice) keep Z = 1. Memory grows as factor^3 in 3D; 2 or 4 is typical for stronger rounding.

IntVectorProperty.name: ResampleInterpolation
IntVectorProperty.label: Resample Interpolation
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Ignored when Resample Factor is 1. Nearest (default) duplicates occupancy and keeps a binary mask. Linear interpolates then, in Threshold mode, re-thresholds at Threshold so AntiAlias still sees 0/1.

IntVectorProperty.name: BinarizeMode
IntVectorProperty.label: Binarize Mode
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Threshold (default): voxels >= Threshold are inside (1), others outside (0), then ITK anti-alias. Auto min/max: convert to float and let ITK treat the array min as outside and max as inside (correct for 0/1 or 0/255; not for multi-label volumes).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Threshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Used when Binarize Mode is Threshold. Voxels at or above this value are inside.

IntVectorProperty.name: NumberOfIterations
IntVectorProperty.label: Number Of Iterations
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum sparse-field iterations (ITK default 1000). The solver also stops when RMS change drops below Maximum RMS Error.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MaximumRMSError
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Maximum RMS Error
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Convergence threshold (ITK default 0.07). Smaller is tighter but slower; keep below 1.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseImageSpacing
IntVectorProperty.label: Use Image Spacing
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If on, curvature is computed in physical units (ITK UseImageSpacing). Default off matches itk::AntiAliasBinaryImageFilter (voxel index space).
